title: Normalized prelog logification presentations and comparison data
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], use its Zariski and small etale sites [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site], prelog/log structures [def-trf-zariski-log-structure, def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and the unit-pushout congruence [def-trf-log-regular-pair]. Retain the following existing definitions unchanged. A pair class is the congruence class of $(p,a)$. A PrelogPushoutPresentation consists of natural maps from these sectionwise pushouts to a monoid sheaf, with structural formula $[p,a]\mapsto\beta(p)a$, prelog inclusion $p\mapsto[p,1]$, and the unique extension property against all monoid sheaves. The raw inverse image is $W\mapsto P(\operatorname{image}(W\to X))$, and PrelogEtaleInverseImage is its sheafification with unit, structural compatibility with pullback of functions, and its Hom bijection. PrelogCharacteristicPresentation is a sheaf quotient killing monoid units, universal for such maps. The ZariskiUniversal and EtaleUniversal predicates require unique structurally compatible log extensions. ZariskiStalks and EtaleStalks specify the pushout isomorphisms on all section germs, preserving the canonical unit maps; the latter additionally specifies the raw inverse-image stalk isomorphism and the canonical unit-reflecting local-ring map [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Characteristic stalk predicates give the Associates quotient of these pushouts with its formula on every pair germ. Restricts requires the presentations and their pair, inclusion, and quotient maps on every slice to be exactly the restrictions of the original data. PrelogLogificationComparison specifies the inverse image of the Zariski inclusion and the log isomorphism after re-logification, with the structural and inclusion equations. These are constructions and predicates only, not assertions of existence. Their full formulas are precisely the declarations moved unchanged into the attached module.
